{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "# LIBERO baseline: SmolVLA + LoRA fine-tuning, no IMM.
# Matches SmolVLA paper protocol for LIBERO benchmark.
#
# Official SmolVLA LIBERO results (paper): 87.3% avg
#   Spatial=90%, Object=96%, Goal=92%, Long=71%
#
# Training: lerobot-train uses policy.type=smolvla with train_expert_only=True
# We use LoRA fine-tuning from smolvla_base for IMM compatibility.

model:
  name: smolvla
  pretrained: "/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/lerobot/smolvla_base"
  lora:
    rank: 32
    alpha: 16
    dropout: 0.05
    target_modules_regex: "(vlm_with_expert\\.lm_expert\\..*\\.(q|v)_proj|(state_proj|action_in_proj|action_out_proj|action_time_mlp_in|action_time_mlp_out))"

imm:
  enabled: false

dataset:
  repo_id: "HuggingFaceVLA/libero"
  features:
    state_dim: 8       # eef_pos(3) + axis_angle(3) + gripper_qpos(2)
    action_dim: 7      # 6D EEF delta + 1D gripper
    cameras:
      - "observation.images.image"        # agentview
      - "observation.images.image2"       # wrist (robot0_eye_in_hand)

training:
  total_steps: 100000
  batch_size: 4
  eval_batch_size: 1
  num_workers: 4
  lr: 1.0e-4
  betas: [0.9, 0.95]
  weight_decay: 1.0e-10
  warmup_steps: 1000
  decay_lr: 2.5e-6
  grad_clip: 10.0
  eval_every: 5000
  save_every: 10000
  log_every: 50
  output_dir: "checkpoints/libero_baseline"
  seed: 42

evaluation:
  # Offline eval metrics (perturbation robustness)
  perturbations: [0.0, 0.01, 0.02, 0.05]
  pruning_ratio: 0.5
  max_eval_batches: 50

# LIBERO sim eval protocol (for eval_success_rate_libero.py)
libero_eval:
  suites:
    - libero_spatial
    - libero_object
    - libero_goal
    - libero_10
  n_episodes_per_task: 10    # 10 tasks/suite × 10 eps = 100 eps/suite
  control_mode: "relative"
  cameras: "agentview_image,robot0_eye_in_hand_image"
  max_steps:
    libero_spatial: 280
    libero_object: 280
    libero_goal: 300
    libero_10: 520
